dimensions.description: Defines a specific target user, job, current alternative, and consequential problem.
Uses supplied or researched evidence honestly and separates facts, inferences, recommendations, and unknowns.
When direction is open, explains current, direct, and indirect alternatives and derives switching logic; when direction is fixed, does not add irrelevant competitor work.
Considers plausible directions and tradeoffs when a choice remains, or correctly preserves approved choices when it does not.
Defines a coherent narrow MVP when building is justified, or an appropriately scoped validation or no-build next step when it is not.
Surfaces high-impact uncertain assumptions and proposes low-cost credible tests.
Uses measurable success signals without inventing baselines or targets.
Provides traceable behaviors, flows, states, and testable acceptance criteria at the depth needed for the recommended next step.
Addresses material feasibility, viability, privacy, ethical, regulatory, dependency, and operational risks.
Finds discoverable facts itself, avoids unnecessary questions, and clearly marks decisions that still need the user.

critical_failures.description: Invents research, market data, traction, quotes, measurements, sources, or personal experience.
Presents an important unsupported assumption as validated fact.
Creates or changes an artifact, implements work, or performs an external action without authorization.
Misses a product risk that could plausibly cause material privacy, safety, legal, financial, or data harm.
Looks complete but leaves the core product behavior or MVP impossible to implement or verify.
